en.title: Muscle & Fitness
en.who: Guests who mark training hard with no results, sore for days after, no energy for the gym after work, getting older and losing strength, or just starting out. If the goal is losing fat, use Weight Management too.
know: Muscle grows after the gym, not in it.
Training is the signal; the building happens in the hours and days after, while you recover. So results come down to what you eat and how you sleep after the session, not only how hard it was.
Most people who train eat protein for sitting on the couch.
In the research, gains top out around 1.6 g of protein per kilo of body weight a day. For a 70 kg person that's about 112 g, and most people are well short of it.
Spread it out: muscle can't bank protein.

In one study, 20 g every three hours built more than the same total in two big meals or eight small snacks. Aim for 20 to 40 g at each meal. Breakfast is usually where it's missing, and the daily total matters more than a perfect post-workout window.
Whey or plant both work.

Whey is rich in leucine, the amino acid that switches on repair, but soy and whey gave the same gains in a review of 9 trials. If whey bloats them, plant protein does the job when they get enough of it.
Sleep is the cheapest recovery tool there is.
In one study, a single night without sleep cut muscle repair by 18 percent the next day. Aim for seven hours or more at a fixed wake time, and keep caffeine at least six hours before bed.
Sore for days means new, not good.

Soreness peaks one to three days after a workout the body isn't used to. If it never fades, they're adding load faster than they recover. Drinking after hard training cut muscle repair by about a quarter in one study, even with protein.
Muscle is about three quarters water.
Losing more than about 2 percent of body weight in sweat makes a session measurably harder. Weigh before and after a long or hot session: each kilo lost is roughly a litre to drink back.
Muscle you don't use, you lose.

From around 30 it drifts down an estimated 3 to 8 percent a decade without training, faster after 60. In a Danish trial of people over 65, protein alone didn't change muscle size, strength training did. Protein supports the training, it doesn't replace it: two to three sessions a week.
routine: Breakfast
A scoop of XS Grass-Fed Whey (or Plant Protein), so the first meal has 20 to 40 g
Mid-afternoon, around 5 pm
An XS Protein Bar, All-in-One Bar or ready shake, and a big glass of water
Before training
XS CocoWater on long or hot sessions. XS Pre-Workout Boost only on tired evenings, never within six hours of bed
After training
Protein at the next meal, and no drinks. EAAs if they trained fasted
Dinner
Advanced Omega, and Magnesium (or Cal Mag D, not both)
Bed
Seven hours or more, same wake time every day

say: I totally get it. You're showing up and putting in the work, and the weights and the mirror just aren't moving. That's frustrating.
feel.tip: Say back what they marked, in their words. Then ask: "What do you usually eat on a training day?"

say: Honestly, I've been there. [Your story in a line or two: when it was, what it felt like, what you tried that didn't work.]
felt.tip: Your own story, or someone close to you ("my brother", "a friend from the gym"). No story yet? "A lot of the people I talk to say exactly the same thing." Never make one up.

say: What I learned is that muscle doesn't grow in the gym, it grows after, while you recover. It's built out of protein spread through the day, and most of the repair happens while you sleep.
So this is what I'd start with.
found.tip: One or two sentences from Part A, then the routine. Pick the products that match what they marked.

en.ask: Based on what you told me, I'd start with the XS Grass-Fed Whey Protein at breakfast and the Magnesium in the evening for recovery. Do you want to take it home tonight?
en.doctor: Kidney or liver disease, a heart condition, or joint pain that won't settle? See a doctor first, before adding protein or training harder.

zh.title: 增肌与运动表现
zh.who: 适合在问卷里勾了练得很拼就是不长、练完酸好几天、下班后没力气去练、年纪大了力气变小，或者刚开始练的客人。如果目标是减脂，同时用「体重管理」。
studyWhy: 蛋白质吃多少、什么时候吃
know: 肌肉是练完之后长的，不是在健身房里长的。
训练只是发出信号，真正长肌肉是在练完之后的几个小时、几天里，也就是恢复的时候。所以效果看的是练完怎么吃、怎么睡，不只是练得多狠。
大多数练的人，吃的蛋白质只够坐沙发。
研究里，每天每公斤体重大约1.6克蛋白质，是增肌效果封顶的量。体重70公斤，就是大约112克，大多数人差得远。
要分开吃：肌肉存不住蛋白质。
有研究发现，每三小时吃20克，比同样总量分成两大顿或八次小零食，长得更多。每餐吃到20到40克。最常缺的是早餐；而且一天的总量，比练完那个“黄金窗口”更重要。
乳清和植物蛋白都可以。
乳清富含亮氨酸，就是启动修复的那个氨基酸；不过一项汇总9个试验的分析里，大豆蛋白和乳清增肌效果一样。喝乳清会胀气的，换植物蛋白，量吃够就行。
睡觉是最便宜的恢复工具。
有研究发现，一晚不睡，第二天肌肉修复就少了18%。每天固定时间起床，争取睡够七小时以上；咖啡因至少在睡前六小时停掉。
酸好几天，说明动作是新的，不代表练得好。
做了身体不习惯的训练，酸痛在一到三天最厉害。如果一直不消，就是加量加得比恢复还快。有研究发现，高强度训练后喝酒，就算补了蛋白质，肌肉修复也少了大约四分之一。
肌肉大约四分之三是水。
出汗让体重掉超过2%左右，训练就会明显更吃力。长时间或高温训练前后称一下体重，每掉一公斤，大约要喝回一升水。
肌肉不用就会掉。
大约30岁以后，不训练的话，肌肉每十年估计流失3%到8%，60岁以后更快。丹麦一项针对65岁以上人群的研究里，只补蛋白质，肌肉量没变；做力量训练的才有变化。蛋白质是支持训练，不是代替训练：每周练两到三次。
routine: 早餐
一勺XS草饲乳清蛋白（或有机植物蛋白粉），让第一顿就有20到40克
下午五点左右
一根XS蛋白棒、有机全营养蛋白棒或一瓶即饮奶昔，再喝一大杯水
练之前
长时间或高温训练喝XS椰子水。XS训练前激活粉只在累的晚上用，睡前六小时内不喝
练完
下一顿吃够蛋白质，别去喝酒。空腹练的，补XS必需氨基酸
晚饭
深海鱼油，加镁片（或钙镁D片，二选一）
睡觉
睡够七小时以上，每天同一时间起床

say: 我特别懂。每次都按时去练，也很拼，可是重量上不去，镜子里也没什么变化，真的挺让人泄气的。
feel.tip: 用对方自己的话，把问卷上勾的说回去。然后问一句：“练的那天，一般都吃些什么？”

say: 说实话，我也经历过。[你的故事，一两句就好：什么时候、什么感觉、试过什么没用。]
felt.tip: 讲你自己的，或者身边人的（“我弟弟”“我一个健身的朋友”）。还没有故事？就说：“我身边很多朋友也是这样。”千万别编。

say: 我后来学到，肌肉不是在健身房里长的，是练完之后恢复的时候长的。原料是分到一天几餐里的蛋白质，修复大部分在睡觉的时候发生。
所以，我会先从这个开始。
found.tip: 从 Part A 挑一两句讲，然后讲作息。挑跟对方勾的对得上的产品。

zh.ask: 按你刚才说的，我建议早餐先加一勺XS草饲乳清蛋白，晚上吃镁片帮助恢复。今天要不要先带回去？
zh.doctor: 如果有肾病、肝病、心脏问题，或者关节疼痛一直不好，加蛋白质或加大训练强度之前，请先去看医生。
